description: Finish a draft before it is shown for approval: review the whole draft end to end (every platform version, tweet, slide and image) for coherence, flow, completeness, brand and foreign logos, then fix what is unfinished (split or tighten tweets, write missing tweets or slides, align the set's facts, regenerate a failed visual, clean a source's branding). Returns ready (Top pick eligible) or finishing with the open defects. Never schedules or publishes.
name: bamf.finish_draft
